correctness.rationale: Strictly positive rational local gaps for six edge-subtree and seven vertex moves; exact quadratic variance identity; all 64 partitions and the three tied global optima checked through exact Gaussian elimination. Seven variable-screening rational identities rederived symbolically; the interval is certified via monotone polynomial and signed factors. The weak-pendant-leaf extension uses a strictly positive exact leading coefficient, finite continuity of all old inequalities and persistent strict competitor gain, proving all arbitrary finite sizes without relying on finite tests.

value.rationale: Demonstrates a nontrivial barrier to variance-oriented trace-probing partition refinement on bipartite weighted trees. Simultaneous vertex/subtree strict local stationarity and a globally better improper coloring contradict the heuristic sufficiency of proper coloring and strong local rearrangements. Exact screening window and positive-conductance arbitrary-order extension make the counterexample robust and structurally informative.
